    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdjacentArmorBlockInteraction
    Gives extra protection if this item is next to armor items in the backpack.
    Backpack
    Represents the hero's backpack.
    BackpackPlacement
    Manages item placement logic in the backpack.
    BackpackSearch
    Manages item search logic in the backpack.
    BackpackView
    Shows a backpack on screen.
    BattleView
     
    Button
     
    ClickableItems
     
    Controller
    Main game controller.
    CurseBladeInteraction
    Deals extra damage to the enemy for each curse item next to this item in the backpack.
    CurseView
     
    DamagePerTurnEffect
    Applies extra damage per turn from an item.
    DeleteButton
    Represents a "DELETE" button that updates its position based on the screen size.
    Dungeon
    Represents a dungeon with multiple floors.
    EndTurnButton
    Represents an "END TURN" button that updates its position based on screen size.
    Enemies
    Manages the enemies on a floor.
    Enemy
    Represents an enemy in the game.
    EnemyData
    Stores the data for an enemy.
    Fighter
    Interface for any combat participant.
    FightGraphics
    Manages the graphical interface and state of a fight.
    Floor
    Represents a floor in the dungeon with a grid of rooms.
    GameGraphics
    Initializes the game graphics, dungeon, hero, and floor.
    GoldCleaverInteraction
    Gives extra damage to the enemy for each adjacent item with "Cleaver" in its name.
    HallOfFame
    Manages the hall of fame of the game.
    HallOfFameView
    Displays the Hall of Fame screen.
    HealButton
    Represents a "HEAL" button that allows the hero to spend gold to restore health.
    Healer
    Saves the data for a healer service.
    HealerView
     
    Hero
    Represents the player character and implements Fighter.
    HeroFight
    Saves and manages the hero's combat-related stats.
    HeroInventoryManager
    Manages the hero's inventory and transactions.
    HeroProgression
    Tracks the hero's experience and level progression.
    HeroView
     
    ImageLoader
    Loads and saves images from a directory for drawing.
    Item
    Represents an item with stats, shape, effects, and interactions.
    ItemData
    Saves immutable data for an item.
    ItemDeleteView
    Creates a view to delete items.
    ItemEffect
    Interface for item effects applied to the enemy during a fight.
    ItemInteraction
    Represents a special effect that an item can give during a fight.
    ItemPlacementView
    Creates a view to place one item.
    ItemRarity
    Represents the rarity levels of an item.
    ItemRegistry
     
    ItemRotation
    Manages rotation logic for an item.
    Items
    Manages a collection of items.
    ItemShapes
    Defines common item shapes for the game.
    ItemsView
    Creates a view to show all items.
    ItemType
    Represents the different types of items in the game.
    KeySwordInteraction
    Gives extra damage to the enemy for each adjacent item named "Key".
    Main
    Main Class of the application.
    ManageBackpack
    Manages interactions between the hero's backpack and the merchant.
    MapView
    Creates a view for the dungeon map.
    MenuView
    Creates the main menu view.
    Merchant
    Represents a merchant selling items.
    MerchantView
    Creates the merchant view.
    Message
    Represents a message with text and the time when it should disappear.
    MessageView
    Creates a view to show messages on the screen.
    PoisonArrowEffect
    Applies poison to an enemy from a poison arrow item.
    PoisonEffect
    Applies a fixed poison effect to an enemy.
    RefuseButton
    Represents a "REFUSE" button that can be clicked by the player.
    RoboBucklerInteraction
    Gives protection to the hero for each weapon on the same line.
    Room
    Represents a room in a dungeon floor.
    RotateButton
    Represents a "ROTATE" button that rotates an item when clicked.
    SellButton
    Represents a "SELL" button that allows the player to sell an item.
    TreasureView
    Creates a view for treasure collection.
    VictoryView
    Creates a victory view.
    View
    Interface for all views in the game.
